t01-road.note: The two stacked one-way cuttings, one runner on each going opposite ways, the Dolphin beyond, a dead sundial on the headland.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: pale limestone sea-cliffs above surf, a small port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs beyond, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real rock, scrub, stone and roof tile. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its runner, pouch and sundial exactly. Cut into the cliff face above the surf, two narrow single-file road shelves run one above the other, a few metres apart, each just wide enough for one cart, with no passing places. On the upper shelf one runner (broad felt hat, ochre tunic, pouch at hip) jogs toward the town; on the lower shelf a second runner dressed the same jogs away from it. On the headland above, the board's weathered stone sundial, casting no shadow. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

t03-slip.note: Lamportios at the mouth of the cutting above the Dolphin's quay, handing a runner a slip with the tally on it.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a cliff road descending to the stone quay and harbour of a small port town, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real rock, scrub, stone and roof tile. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its two men and objects exactly. The road is two narrow single-file shelves cut one above the other in the cliff, ramping down into the town. In the foreground at the mouth of the upper shelf: the elderly bald man with the short grey beard, cream chiton with ochre border and satchel hands one narrow papyrus slip to the runner (broad felt hat, ochre tunic), who slips it into the pouch at his hip, ready to set off along the shelf. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.
